source: Per-company AR extraction (Screener.in PDFs + IR sites) — Claude.ai routine, daily batch of 20

china_plus_one.evidence: International revenue only ~Rs 57.5 cr of Rs 2,066.9 cr FY25 revenue (just under 3%), described as a 'long-dated bonus'; no China+1 or export-manufacturing narrative (DSIJ).

rural.evidence: No rural share disclosed. FY25 offline reach expanded to ~1.2 lakh billed outlets under Project Neev GT restructuring; direct distributors 71% of Q4 FY25 revenue (Inc42, Storyboard18).

inr_exposure.evidence: International sales ~2.8% of revenue (derived: 57.5/2,066.9, DSIJ); currency mix not disclosed.

china_plus_one.evidence: Royal Enfield FY25 exports up ~37% to ~1.0-1.07 lakh units of 10.03 lakh total (~10-11% of volume, derived; revenue share not disclosed); expanding in SE Asia, Europe, LatAm across 80+ countries. No China+1 framing (Mobility Outlook, IIFL MD&A, Machinist).

govt_capex.evidence: Indirect only: JV VECV (54.4% stake) sells commercial vehicles/buses, tied to infrastructure and freight cycle; no share disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: Export mix and realisations cited as Q4 FY25 margin driver; April 2026 reports note currency pressures in select export markets. No USD revenue share found.

pli_scheme.evidence: VECV stated intent (2021) to tap auto PLI via EV route; no confirmed approval or incentive found (Business Standard).

china_plus_one.evidence: Export share ~6%, targeted to exceed 10% in two years; Dubai plant ramping (58% utilisation Q3 FY25) and new export-focused 300kt Bhuj plant. No explicit China+1 framing (Quartr Q4 FY25 call summary).

govt_capex.evidence: Structural tubes serve construction and infrastructure; no government-project revenue share disclosed.

crude_exposure.evidence: Main input is steel (raw material cost ~Rs 17,870 cr, ~86% of Rs 20,690 cr FY25 revenue, derived); not crude-linked. FY25 EBITDA/t fell to ~Rs 3,800-3,900 on steel price volatility (company earnings presentation, Quartr).

inr_exposure.evidence: Exports ~6% of business, largely via Dubai subsidiary; currency mix and hedging policy not found.

china_plus_one.evidence: FY25 exports ~9% of IMFL sales value / ~5% of volume (Q4 FY25 concall via Arthneeti); BRSR puts exports at 1.71% of gross turnover (gross includes excise). Sells in ~100 countries; UK (Scotland) subsidiary set up. No diversification or China+1 angle.

crude_exposure.evidence: Key inputs are grain/ENA, molasses and glass, not crude; some regular SKUs moved to PET bottles. Backward integration via 350 KLPD Sitapur grain distillery (~95% utilisation) (Alphastreet, FundsIndia).

inr_exposure.evidence: Exports ~9% of IMFL value; currency mix and hedging not found.

china_plus_one.evidence: Domestic diagnostics; international operations under 2% of revenue (FundsIndia). FY25 regional mix: Delhi-NCR 31%, UP & UK 19%, East 15%, West 14%, Rest of North 13%, South 6%, other 2%.

rural.evidence: No rural share disclosed; 18 new labs in FY25 extended footprint into Tier 3/4 cities (FundsIndia/Alphastreet).

inr_exposure.evidence: International revenue under 2% (exact figure not given); reagents are partly imported, but no figures found.

china_plus_one.evidence: FY25 investor presentation (NSE) revenue mix: North America 41%, India 29%, Europe 24%, Asia 6%, RoW 0.3%. Strong export momentum and record EV order book, but no explicit China+1 attribution found; company even explored (then shelved) a China JV in 2025 (FilingReader/Angel One).

govt_capex.evidence: Management cited railways as a diversification avenue (Mint), no revenue share disclosed.

inr_exposure.evidence: North America (mostly US) was 41% of FY25 revenue (Mint); currency denomination and hedging policy not found in search snippets. Management estimated US tariffs could impact ~3% of revenue.

pli_scheme.evidence: First auto-component company to receive Auto PLI certification; four products approved, with three more traction motors certified in Aug 2025 (MarkLines, Turn of Speed).

china_plus_one.evidence: Domestic beauty/fashion e-commerce platform; no export business. FY25 consolidated GMV Rs 15,604 cr, up 25% (Business Standard).

rural.evidence: Beauty business expects Tier III+ towns to contribute about two-thirds of GMV (Business Standard); forward-looking, not a rural revenue share, so not used.

china_plus_one.evidence: Standalone FY25 product sales Rs 169,316 mn, of which exports Rs 14,054 mn (vs 12,790 mn in FY24) per MD&A (IndiaInfoline); export share 8.3% derived. Powertrain sales growth helped by exports (Bosch press release); no diversification angle found.

inr_exposure.evidence: Exports ~8.3% of product sales (derived, IndiaInfoline MD&A); currency mix and hedging policy not found.

pli_scheme.evidence: Approved under Auto PLI Component Champion category (MHI Lok Sabha reply, Dec 2025) and received PLI DVA certification from ICAT in Dec 2024 (Mobility Outlook).

china_plus_one.evidence: International markets ~54% of FY25 revenue, India 46% (StockScans; a TTM investor presentation cites 45% domestic). Europe revenue Rs 1,474 cr of Rs 7,896 cr total (Investywise/company press release), ~18.7% derived. No China+1 narrative; management noted R-Asparaginase is imported from China (Q4 FY25 call).

inr_exposure.evidence: International ~54% of revenue but largely Europe/Canada (EUR/CAD), so USD share not set; hedging policy not found.

pli_scheme.evidence: No evidence found of Emcure being a PLI beneficiary.

china_plus_one.evidence: Domestic apparel retailer: 248 Westside, 765 Zudio (2 in UAE) and 30 other stores at Mar-2025 (Storyboard18); no export business. Predominantly domestic vendor base (ICICI Securities).

rural.evidence: Zudio spans 235 cities; 1,043 stores across 242 cities (integrated report summary). No tier/rural revenue split disclosed.

china_plus_one.evidence: Aditya Birla Capital's Q4FY25 note cites India at ~90% of FY25 revenue. Separately, management (Autocar Pro) puts the export share at ~14% and targets 20-25% as it expands its global footprint. No explicit China+1 framing was found.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY25 consolidated revenue was Rs 16,775 cr. No currency split or hedging policy was found in search results.

pli_scheme.evidence: A Ministry of Heavy Industries parliamentary reply (Dec 2025) lists UNO Minda Ltd as an approved 'Component Champion' applicant under PLI-Auto, alongside Denso Ten Uno Minda. No incentive amount was disclosed.

china_plus_one.evidence: sharpely.in's FY25 geographic split shows India at 99.3% and outside India at 0.7% (~Rs 181 cr). MarketScreener puts India at 99.6% of net sales. Exports are negligible, with no diversification narrative.

crude_exposure.evidence: The key input is ENA (grain/molasses-based alcohol), not crude. Q4FY25 coverage (Kotak) describes the commodity environment as stable with mild ENA inflation; no crude-linked share was disclosed.

china_plus_one.evidence: Moneycontrol and Medpath report that Anthem pitched itself in its IPO as a China alternative for global pharma, saying cost arbitrage drove its expansion. Per the RHP data in SBI Securities' IPO note, FY25 exports were 83.44% of revenue (Europe 54.6%, North America 26.4%). Caveat: a Substack analysis says imported raw materials rose to 48.4% in FY25, much of it from China.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Reportedly relies on a natural hedge, with imports offsetting part of export receipts, rather than formal hedging contracts (Substack analysis; not confirmed against the RHP).
inr_exposure.evidence: Exports are ~83% of FY25 revenue, billed in USD/EUR (Substack). USD share is not set because Europe (54.6%) is the larger market and EUR billing is likely significant.

china_plus_one.evidence: This is a hospitality business with no export narrative. 'Export' here means international hotels (US, UK, Cape Town, Dubai, Sri Lanka), which Asian Hospitality (May 2025) puts at ~20% of consolidated revenue, with the two US hotels at ~10%.

rate_sensitive.evidence: Debt is minimal. Consolidated long-term borrowings were Rs 224.7 cr at 31 Mar 2025, short-term borrowings were nil, and the group held Rs 3,072.5 cr of cash (FY25 directors' report via IIFL/Arihant). FY25 finance cost was Rs 100 cr. No floating-rate split was found.

inr_exposure.evidence: Asian Hospitality says the US hotels (The Pierre, Campton Place) contribute ~10% of consolidated revenue; that revenue is USD by nature, which is an inference. UK revenue is GBP; no split was found.

china_plus_one.evidence: Quartr earnings summaries put exports at 76% of revenue in Q2 and Q3 FY25 and 74% in Q4 FY25; the FY26 BRSR also gives 76%. Commentary (FundsIndia, Tradejini) frames the company as the first Indian firm outside China making electrolyte additives and semiconductor chemicals, with China+1 as a tailwind. Growth is not explicitly attributed to China+1.

inr_exposure.evidence: FY25 revenue was ~Rs 1,007 cr, up 40%, and ~76% came from exports to 27+ countries. No currency split or hedging policy was found.

pli_scheme.evidence: Commentary cites India's PLI schemes as a sector tailwind for its battery and semiconductor chemicals push, but no beneficiary approval was found.

china_plus_one.evidence: Large export business (FY25 revenue Rs 8,770 cr; India 30%, North America 41%, Continental Europe 19%, Middle East & RoW 10% per aggregator summaries of company disclosures), but growth is attributed to brand/basmati share gains (54% of US basmati imports per Q4 FY25 call), not China+1.

crude_exposure.evidence: Key raw material is paddy/basmati rice; no crude-linked raw material share disclosed.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Company has a formal forex policy (adopted ~FY12 per annual report) and reportedly hedges currency exposure; specific hedge ratios not found.
inr_exposure.evidence: ~70% of revenue is earned outside India (North America 41%), but a USD-denominated share is not disclosed in snippets (overseas subsidiaries earn in USD/EUR/GBP). FY12 annual report cites adopting a focused forex policy; ValuePickr commentary says the company hedges.

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI benefit found in searches.

china_plus_one.evidence: Domestic LNG import/regasification business (FY25 throughput 934 TBTU per Quartr); no export or China+1 narrative.

govt_capex.evidence: Offtakers are largely PSU promoters (GAIL, IOC, BPCL, ONGC) under long-term contracts, but no revenue share figure found.

crude_exposure.evidence: LNG is the main purchase (FY25 revenue Rs 50,982 cr consolidated); per ICRA, long-term Qatar supply contracts are back-to-back with offtake agreements that pass price risk to customers, so crude-linked LNG price exposure is largely passed through. No % figure found.

inr_exposure.evidence: LNG purchases are USD-linked but passed through to offtakers (ICRA); regas tariffs are INR-denominated (Argus). Notional forex losses arise on USD lease liabilities (e.g. Rs 124 cr in Q1 FY23). No hedging policy found.

china_plus_one.evidence: Exports ~10% of portfolio per Q1 CY2024 analyst call (exports grew 23%) and Q4 2024 summary (Quartr); a Q1 CY2025 broker note put domestic/export at 93%/7%. No explicit China+1 narrative found.

govt_capex.evidence: CY2024 orders Rs 13,079 cr / revenue Rs 12,188 cr; growth driven by data centers and railways, with management crediting government infrastructure investment (ABB press releases), while Business Standard noted weak government orders. No government revenue share disclosed.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: Management cites 'prudent and timely hedging actions against currency & commodity volatility' (Q1 CY2025 release); no formal ratio disclosed.
inr_exposure.evidence: Exports ~10% of revenue but currency mix not disclosed; forex volatility hit Q2 CY2025 profit (Business Standard). Import exposure on components likely larger than export revenue.

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI beneficiary listing found for ABB India.

china_plus_one.evidence: 77% of FY25 revenue (Rs 2,109 cr) from exports per aggregator summaries (Quartr/dcf-analysis); US is ~45-50% of revenue (export_us_pct uses the 45% lower bound). Growth attributed to value-added films/PPF (PPF revenue +25% YoY), not China+1; US tariffs hit Q2 FY26 revenue (-8.2%).

rate_sensitive.evidence: Low leverage; CARE (Jul 2025) cut long-term bank facilities to Rs 80 cr from Rs 149 cr.

crude_exposure.evidence: Key raw materials PTA and MEG (PET chips) are crude-linked per MD&A (IIFL) and CARE rating rationale; a third-party site puts PET chips/resins at ~52% of raw material cost, but no share of total costs disclosed by company.

inr_exposure.hedging_policy: MD&A cites 'active hedging and procurement strategies'; long-term import-parity-priced raw material agreement; details of FX hedge cover not found.

pli_scheme.evidence: No PLI benefit found in searches.

china_plus_one.evidence: Domestic port/logistics operator (FY25 cargo ~117 MT, +9%; third-party cargo share 49% vs 40%); no export or China+1 narrative found.

govt_capex.evidence: Ports operate under concessions from government/port authorities; group (JSW Steel etc.) cargo is ~51% of volumes in FY25 (third-party 49%, Business Standard). No govt revenue share.
